profile_production_grid.configuration: VPW99 TWO, top cell 1 mm, stretch 1.0488, depth 1 m (51 layers), production dt (4320 steps per solar day)
profile_production_grid.decision: No specialized CUDA tridiagonal kernel. The backend-generic Thomas solve is ~31% of the instrumented GPU step, and the step is launch-bound (4x the columns costs only 1.4x the time), so a fused kernel could save at most ~30% of a ~1-1.5 h experiment. The single implementation is kept.
